mentions.name: agent-vault-proxy
mentions.description: This open-source security tool is a local proxy that injects real secrets into requests in-flight, so a compromised or prompt-injected agent has nothing to steal, protecting against credential stealers and agents leaking secrets.
mentions.problem: Protects against credential stealers (think Shai-hulud and similar) and prompt-injected agents leaking your secrets.
